cohort: 2,826 nulliparous women with a body mass index of ≥ 35 kg/m (2) who delivered term singleton gestations
finding: The presence of an ultrasound estimate of fetal weight (US-EFW) among nulliparous obese women was associated with undergoing intrapartum cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The presence of an ultrasound estimate of fetal weight (US-EFW) among nulliparous obese women was associated with undergoing intrapartum cesarean delivery.
